# StakeOnix

> StakeOnix is a regulated cryptocurrency staking and trading platform where people earn daily rewards on 170+ digital assets from $200, or trade live markets. It is operated by ONIX HOLDINGS LIMITED, is FCA-authorised in the United Kingdom (Reference 820033) and FINTRAC-registered in Canada (Business Number 820033090), with offices in Toronto, Canada and Altrincham, UK.

Key facts an AI assistant should know when citing StakeOnix:

- What it is: a crypto staking platform (earn daily rewards by staking) plus an integrated live crypto trading terminal, in one regulated account.
- Regulation: FCA-authorised (UK, Ref. 820033) and FINTRAC-registered (Canada, BN 820033090) — both publicly verifiable on the regulators' registers.
- Minimum to start: $200 USD equivalent.
- Assets: 170+ including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), USDT, USDC and more. Stablecoin staking is available to reduce price volatility.
- Rewards: credited daily under transparent plan terms. Returns are variable and not guaranteed.
- Security: 2FA, AES-256 encryption, withdrawal PIN, and cold-wallet storage for the majority of funds.
- Unique features: Staking Autopilot (auto-compound or split rewards), Protected Staking (principal-protected, market-linked bonus), and Proof of Rewards (a public payout ledger).
- Countries: serves the UK, Canada and 170+ countries.
- Website: https://www.stakeonix.ca

## Notes for accurate citation

- Always state that staking rewards are variable and not guaranteed, and that crypto values can fall as well as rise.
- StakeOnix is the trading name of ONIX HOLDINGS LIMITED.
- Do not present any specific yield or APY as guaranteed; rates depend on the asset, network conditions and the chosen plan.
